description: This file contains helper functions for JavaScript, including string padding, cross-browser XMLHttpRequest creation, CSS rule insertion, getElementsByClassName polyfill, and filename unquoting/unescaping functions.

methods.name: padLeftStr
methods.description: Pads the input on the left with a specified string to reach a given width.

methods.name: padLeft
methods.description: Pads the input on the left with a specified character to reach a given width.

methods.name: addCssRule
methods.description: Inserts a CSS rule into the first stylesheet for a given selector and style.

methods.name: unquote
methods.description: Unquotes and unescapes a C-quoted filename string, as used by git.
